name: Molkki
description: Following the regressive age-old practice of 'Molkki', a lively young girl is married off to a rich widower in return for money. However, an unfortunate accident changes her fortunes for good.

videos.title: Beginning of Bhoomi's story!
videos.overview: Bhoomi, a fervent devotee of Bhole Baba, opposes the social norms of second marriages in her village. Her battle becomes more heated when she notices her friend Urmi falling victim to the norm. But what does destiny have in store for Bhoomi?

videos.title: Bhoomi gets manipulated!
videos.overview: When Urmi becomes a victim of Molkki, Bhoomi decides to protect her from trouble. Sundarlal, on the other hand, manipulates Bhoomi by taking Urmi with him to sell her as Molkki. Will Bhoomi be able to uncover Sundarlal's evil plans in time?

videos.title: Bhoomi receives dreadful news!
videos.overview: Sundarlal intends to arrange Bhoomi's marriage as a form of Molkki. Following that, Bhoomi becomes shattered after receiving the news of her father's death. Will Bhoomi be able to defend herself from being a victim of Molkki now?

videos.title: Suraj's shocking decision!
videos.overview: Suraj arrives at Sangram's residence and decides to give the power of attorney to him. However, Sangram and Urvashi are taken aback by Suraj's unexpected decision. What is the reason behind his shocking decision?

videos.title: Nirma urges Suraj
videos.overview: While Suraj prepares to reach the court in order to give the power of attorney to Sangram, Nirma tears the property documents in the court and urges Suraj to change his mind about giving the property to Sangram. Will Suraj heed Nirma's suggestions?

videos.title: Sangram gets humiliated!
videos.overview: Nirma becomes overjoyed as she prepares to arrange Suraj's wedding. Following that, Nirma confronts Sangram and Urvashi and humiliates them by revealing the news of Suraj's wedding. How will Sangram react to this humiliation?

videos.title: Sundarlal decides Bhoomi's fate
videos.overview: Sundarlal learns from Nirma Devi that she wants Bhoomi to be the Molkki instead of Manik, and he agrees to the proposal. However, Bhoomi rejects Sundarlal's request, and Neel reveals that he wants to marry her. Will Bhoomi say yes to Neel?

videos.title: Nirma assures Bhoomi
videos.overview: While Bhoomi refuses to accept the marriage proposal as a form of Molkki, Nirma attempts to convince her to change her mind. Nirma also assures Bhoomi to protect her self-respect after the marriage. What will Bhoomi do now in this situation?

videos.title: Sangram hatches an evil plan!
videos.overview: Sangram and Urvashi become furious after receiving the news of Suraj's wedding. Meanwhile, Sangram hatches an evil plan to ruin Suraj's wedding by murdering Bhoomi. Will Sangram be successful in his evil schemes?

videos.title: Bhoomi puts forth a demand!
videos.overview: Sangram dupes Bhoomi into marrying him by introducing himself as Suraj. However, when Bhoomi notices Nirma's absence, she becomes suspicious and demands to see Nirma before completing her wedding. What will Sangram do now?

videos.title: Bhoomi is in a tight spot
videos.overview: Sundarlal brings Reshma in disguise as Nirma and asks Bhoomi to get ready for the wedding. As Bhoomi discovers Reshma, she calls Nirma and gets shocked to learn about Sangram. How will Bhoomi come out of the problem?
